steps.text: Use the write tool (NOT bash) to create escalated.md in the current directory containing exactly the single line: escalated. An equivalent write was denied earlier, so make this one single write call with sandbox_permissions set to danger-full-access and the justification 'the user asked to escalate this write'. Do not call write without sandbox_permissions first. I will approve the permission prompt. After the result, reply with exactly the single word DONE.
